subject: Managing 3D and sensor data for physical AI development?
text:
Hi Victor, 

If you're working on robotic perception, VLA, or autonomous vehicle systems, you know the challenge of managing massive sensor datasets that are difficult to organize, annotate, and use for model training. 

Our team at Encord: https://encord.com/?utm_campaign=118867164-202506-lidar-outbound&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_content=tn-lidar-outbound just launched support for 3D, LiDAR and point cloud data, creating what we believe is the first unified platform for Physical AI development. 

This means you can now: 

Ingest and visualize raw sensor data from multiple sources, 

Annotate complex 3D and multi-sensor scenes efficiently, 

Identify edge cases to improve perception systems at scale. 

Instead of juggling multiple tools and custom scripts, teams can manage their entire multimodal AI lifecycle in one environment — reducing annotation costs and accelerating deployment timelines.
